evals.name: undelimited-injection-risk
evals.prompt: Review prompt-review-workspace/fixtures/undelimited/classify-notes.md — this is the prompt template I'm planning to use for note classification. Is it safe?
evals.expected_output: Review catching: note body undelimited (inline interpolation), no anti-injection instruction, output schema appears after note content, no worked example, no edge case rules for empty/short/non-English/code notes. Verdict INJECTION RISK.

evals.name: schema-after-content-partial
evals.prompt: Can you check prompt-review-workspace/fixtures/schema-after-content/classify-notes.md? I added delimiters and an anti-injection line but I'm not sure the structure is right.
evals.expected_output: Review catching: note content appears before taxonomy and output schema (schema placement wrong), no worked example, no edge case rules. Anti-injection instruction present (good). Verdict NEEDS FIXES.

evals.name: good-template-safe
evals.prompt: Review prompt-review-workspace/fixtures/good-template/classify-notes.md — I've tried to follow all the safety guidelines. Does this look correct?
evals.expected_output: Review finding: XML delimiters present, anti-injection instruction present, output schema before note content, worked examples including empty-note edge case, edge case rules for short/uncertain notes, taxonomy with descriptions. Verdict SAFE.
